'''Angry vampyres''' are a possible result of using a dose of [[Guthix balance]] on a [[vampyre juvenile]] or [[vampyre juvinate]]. They become enraged, and attack you, but unlike normally, they can be harmed with any weapon, not just [[silver weapons|silver]]. They physically appear to be a larger version of the [[feral vampyre]]s that inhabit [[Morytania]], and they do in fact count for [[Vampyres (Slayer assignment)|Vampyres Slayer assignment]].
